meta.title: Garden
meta.description: Flowers cultivated by disaster are alluring and cunning.

units.rawText: As the battle comes to an end, the Entropics in the theater vanish one by one. The purple smoke that surrounds Odette and the vines that bind Odile all crumble to dust.
units.displayText: As the battle comes to an end, the Entropics in the theater vanish one by one. The purple smoke that surrounds Odette and the vines that bind Odile all crumble to dust.

spans.text: As the battle comes to an end, the Entropics in the theater vanish one by one. The purple smoke that surrounds Odette and the vines that bind Odile all crumble to dust.

units.rawText: (Winces) ...My strength... is fading...
units.displayText: (Winces) ...My strength... is fading...

spans.text: (Winces) ...My strength... is fading...

units.rawText: Have we been cast aside in the end...? Why...
units.displayText: Have we been cast aside in the end...? Why...

spans.text: Have we been cast aside in the end...? Why...

units.rawText: Big... sis...
units.displayText: Big... sis...

spans.text: Big... sis...

units.rawText: In the end, Odette and the other infected agents slowly shatter into fragments as well.
units.displayText: In the end, Odette and the other infected agents slowly shatter into fragments as well.

spans.text: In the end, Odette and the other infected agents slowly shatter into fragments as well.

units.rawText: Her eyes remain wide open, unwilling to look away from her big sister until the moment she disintegrates.
units.displayText: Her eyes remain wide open, unwilling to look away from her big sister until the moment she disintegrates.

spans.text: Her eyes remain wide open, unwilling to look away from her big sister until the moment she disintegrates.

units.rawText: It seems that the curtain has fallen for this production at last.
units.displayText: It seems that the curtain has fallen for this production at last.

spans.text: It seems that the curtain has fallen for this production at last.

units.rawText: Odile mutters to herself as she stares at where her little sister has vanished. The purple on her has darkened compared to before.
units.displayText: Odile mutters to herself as she stares at where her little sister has vanished. The purple on her has darkened compared to before.

spans.text: Odile mutters to herself as she stares at where her little sister has vanished. The purple on her has darkened compared to before.

units.rawText: ...Are you awake?
units.displayText: ...Are you awake?

spans.text: ...Are you awake?

units.rawText: Yeah...
units.displayText: Yeah...

spans.text: Yeah...

units.rawText: The Pierides Sector is not large. My sister, my friends, my comrades...
units.displayText: The Pierides Sector is not large. My sister, my friends, my comrades...

spans.text: The Pierides Sector is not large. My sister, my friends, my comrades...

units.rawText: In order to keep the sector running, we all exchanged our permissions for operands...
units.displayText: In order to keep the sector running, we all exchanged our permissions for operands...

spans.text: In order to keep the sector running, we all exchanged our permissions for operands...

options.rawText: Who did you make a deal with?
options.displayText: Who did you make a deal with?

spans.text: Who did you make a deal with?

options.rawText: Where did the Entropy come from?
options.displayText: Where did the Entropy come from?

spans.text: Where did the Entropy come from?

units.rawText: Who is this "mysterious outsider" you were talking about?
units.displayText: Who is this "mysterious outsider" you were talking about?

spans.text: Who is this "mysterious outsider" you were talking about?

units.rawText: I don't know.
units.displayText: I don't know.

spans.text: I don't know.

units.rawText: We didn't see its face.
units.displayText: We didn't see its face.

spans.text: We didn't see its face.

units.rawText: Is the "purple flower" at the heart of the garden?
units.displayText: Is the "purple flower" at the heart of the garden?

spans.text: Is the "purple flower" at the heart of the garden?

units.rawText: Yes. At first, we simply found that we could obtain operands from it.
units.displayText: Yes. At first, we simply found that we could obtain operands from it.

spans.text: Yes. At first, we simply found that we could obtain operands from it.

units.rawText: Then one day, the flower suddenly turned into a data fracture.
units.displayText: Then one day, the flower suddenly turned into a data fracture.

spans.text: Then one day, the flower suddenly turned into a data fracture.

units.rawText: Huge amounts of Entropy poured out of it like the rising tide, instantly engulfing us.
units.displayText: Huge amounts of Entropy poured out of it like the rising tide, instantly engulfing us.

spans.text: Huge amounts of Entropy poured out of it like the rising tide, instantly engulfing us.

units.rawText: She takes her seat again.
units.displayText: She takes her seat again.

spans.text: She takes her seat again.

units.rawText: Staying conscious is really hard at times. If it weren't because of the last bit of hope I had for the sector, I might have long since joined my sister in dancing on the stage already.
units.displayText: Staying conscious is really hard at times. If it weren't because of the last bit of hope I had for the sector, I might have long since joined my sister in dancing on the stage already.

spans.text: Staying conscious is really hard at times. If it weren't because of the last bit of hope I had for the sector, I might have long since joined my sister in dancing on the stage already.

units.rawText: Odile reaches out to me with obvious exhaustion.
units.displayText: Odile reaches out to me with obvious exhaustion.

spans.text: Odile reaches out to me with obvious exhaustion.

units.rawText: Wake me. I can close the data fracture and put an end to the Entropic incursion.
units.displayText: Wake me. I can close the data fracture and put an end to the Entropic incursion.

spans.text: Wake me. I can close the data fracture and put an end to the Entropic incursion.

units.rawText: Please help me save the Pierides Sector.
units.displayText: Please help me save the Pierides Sector.

spans.text: Please help me save the Pierides Sector.

units.rawText: I will.
units.displayText: I will.

spans.text: I will.

units.rawText: The ground beneath our feet begins to shudder. It seems this theater is about to collapse as well.
units.displayText: The ground beneath our feet begins to shudder. It seems this theater is about to collapse as well.

spans.text: The ground beneath our feet begins to shudder. It seems this theater is about to collapse as well.

units.rawText: Can you hang in there?
units.displayText: Can you hang in there?

spans.text: Can you hang in there?

units.rawText: I won't fall before I fulfil my purpose. Don't worry.
units.displayText: I won't fall before I fulfil my purpose. Don't worry.

spans.text: I won't fall before I fulfil my purpose. Don't worry.

units.rawText: Professor! Are you alright?
units.displayText: Professor! Are you alright?

spans.text: Professor! Are you alright?

units.rawText: I told you before, didn't I? I'd come back safely.
units.displayText: I told you before, didn't I? I'd come back safely.

spans.text: I told you before, didn't I? I'd come back safely.

units.rawText: Thank goodness... Thank goodness!
units.displayText: Thank goodness... Thank goodness!

spans.text: Thank goodness... Thank goodness!

units.rawText: It's not yet time to relax, Persicaria.
units.displayText: It's not yet time to relax, Persicaria.

spans.text: It's not yet time to relax, Persicaria.

units.rawText: And the administrator seems to be stirring too... She's not in any danger, is she, Professor?
units.displayText: And the administrator seems to be stirring too... She's not in any danger, is she, Professor?

spans.text: And the administrator seems to be stirring too... She's not in any danger, is she, Professor?

units.rawText: She was lucid when she was talking to me, at least.
units.displayText: She was lucid when she was talking to me, at least.

spans.text: She was lucid when she was talking to me, at least.

units.rawText: You say that, but she looks all dark and black and... Ah, she's moving!
units.displayText: You say that, but she looks all dark and black and... Ah, she's moving!

spans.text: You say that, but she looks all dark and black and... Ah, she's moving!

units.rawText: We watch warily as Odile regains consciousness. After a while, she slowly opens her eyes—they look clear.
units.displayText: We watch warily as Odile regains consciousness. After a while, she slowly opens her eyes—they look clear.

spans.text: We watch warily as Odile regains consciousness. After a while, she slowly opens her eyes—they look clear.

units.rawText: Thank you, Professor.
units.displayText: Thank you, Professor.

spans.text: Thank you, Professor.

units.rawText: She's come to!
units.displayText: She's come to!

spans.text: She's come to!

units.rawText: No, I checked her code, the Entropization isn't completely gone yet. Don't get careless!
units.displayText: No, I checked her code, the Entropization isn't completely gone yet. Don't get careless!

spans.text: No, I checked her code, the Entropization isn't completely gone yet. Don't get careless!

units.rawText: Please relax. As long as my neural cloud is conscious, I will not let them take control of this body.
units.displayText: Please relax. As long as my neural cloud is conscious, I will not let them take control of this body.

spans.text: Please relax. As long as my neural cloud is conscious, I will not let them take control of this body.

units.rawText: That said... I won't hesitate if you lose control.
units.displayText: That said... I won't hesitate if you lose control.

spans.text: That said... I won't hesitate if you lose control.

units.rawText: Yes, of course.
units.displayText: Yes, of course.

spans.text: Yes, of course.

units.rawText: Time is short. Let's talk as we walk.
units.displayText: Time is short. Let's talk as we walk.

spans.text: Time is short. Let's talk as we walk.

units.rawText: ...So the Entropy directly created a data fracture in the Pierides Sector?
units.displayText: ...So the Entropy directly created a data fracture in the Pierides Sector?

spans.text: ...So the Entropy directly created a data fracture in the Pierides Sector?

units.rawText: No wonder there were so many of them, and we couldn't respond to it at all...
units.displayText: No wonder there were so many of them, and we couldn't respond to it at all...

spans.text: No wonder there were so many of them, and we couldn't respond to it at all...

units.rawText: The passage was opened in the garden that my sister and I had built together. I'll take you there.
units.displayText: The passage was opened in the garden that my sister and I had built together. I'll take you there.

spans.text: The passage was opened in the garden that my sister and I had built together. I'll take you there.

units.rawText: Alright... But who...
units.displayText: Alright... But who...

spans.text: Alright... But who...

units.rawText: I don't know. We don't even know the reason why...
units.displayText: I don't know. We don't even know the reason why...

spans.text: I don't know. We don't even know the reason why...

units.rawText: Urk!
units.displayText: Urk!

spans.text: Urk!

units.rawText: Odile suddenly stumbles in the middle of her sentence and nearly falls. Sol and Persicaria rush to support her from the side.
units.displayText: Odile suddenly stumbles in the middle of her sentence and nearly falls. Sol and Persicaria rush to support her from the side.

spans.text: Odile suddenly stumbles in the middle of her sentence and nearly falls. Sol and Persicaria rush to support her from the side.

units.rawText: I'm sorry... I might still be a little weak...
units.displayText: I'm sorry... I might still be a little weak...

spans.text: I'm sorry... I might still be a little weak...

units.rawText: The Entropy is still causing havoc in my neural cloud—urgh!
units.displayText: The Entropy is still causing havoc in my neural cloud—urgh!

spans.text: The Entropy is still causing havoc in my neural cloud—urgh!

units.rawText: Are you alright!?
units.displayText: Are you alright!?

spans.text: Are you alright!?

units.rawText: It's an anti-firewall attack. The virus is still trying to break your firewall and take over your neural cloud.
units.displayText: It's an anti-firewall attack. The virus is still trying to break your firewall and take over your neural cloud.

spans.text: It's an anti-firewall attack. The virus is still trying to break your firewall and take over your neural cloud.

units.rawText: You're already pushing it by forcibly reallocating operands to resist the virus... You won't be able to hold out much longer.
units.displayText: You're already pushing it by forcibly reallocating operands to resist the virus... You won't be able to hold out much longer.

spans.text: You're already pushing it by forcibly reallocating operands to resist the virus... You won't be able to hold out much longer.

units.rawText: The Exiles can give you some operand support. That might make the upcoming battles a little tense, but we can still squeeze a little out.
units.displayText: The Exiles can give you some operand support. That might make the upcoming battles a little tense, but we can still squeeze a little out.

spans.text: The Exiles can give you some operand support. That might make the upcoming battles a little tense, but we can still squeeze a little out.

units.rawText: Then... I'll be counting on you, Professor.
units.displayText: Then... I'll be counting on you, Professor.

spans.text: Then... I'll be counting on you, Professor.

units.rawText: Odile, focus your operands on your neural cloud firewall.
units.displayText: Odile, focus your operands on your neural cloud firewall.

spans.text: Odile, focus your operands on your neural cloud firewall.

units.rawText: Do not allocate it anywhere else, no matter what happens. Otherwise you might not be able to stop the Entropy's attack.
units.displayText: Do not allocate it anywhere else, no matter what happens. Otherwise you might not be able to stop the Entropy's attack.

spans.text: Do not allocate it anywhere else, no matter what happens. Otherwise you might not be able to stop the Entropy's attack.

units.rawText: I will remember that... Thank you for your support.
units.displayText: I will remember that... Thank you for your support.

spans.text: I will remember that... Thank you for your support.

units.rawText: Persicaria, give me a hand, we'll transfer operands into her. Everyone else, watch your surroundings and don't get ambushed by the Entropics.
units.displayText: Persicaria, give me a hand, we'll transfer operands into her. Everyone else, watch your surroundings and don't get ambushed by the Entropics.

spans.text: Persicaria, give me a hand, we'll transfer operands into her. Everyone else, watch your surroundings and don't get ambushed by the Entropics.

units.rawText: No problem. I can handle lookout duty.
units.displayText: No problem. I can handle lookout duty.

spans.text: No problem. I can handle lookout duty.

units.rawText: Hehe, it feels like Wisdom has totally become one of the Prof's subordinates.
units.displayText: Hehe, it feels like Wisdom has totally become one of the Prof's subordinates.

spans.text: Hehe, it feels like Wisdom has totally become one of the Prof's subordinates.

units.rawText: Sub... subordinate!?
units.displayText: Sub... subordinate!?

spans.text: Sub... subordinate!?

units.rawText: Yeah. Why don't you just quit being a Sanctifier and join the Oasis? We can give you a shed to sleep in, you know.
units.displayText: Yeah. Why don't you just quit being a Sanctifier and join the Oasis? We can give you a shed to sleep in, you know.

spans.text: Yeah. Why don't you just quit being a Sanctifier and join the Oasis? We can give you a shed to sleep in, you know.

units.rawText: Are... are you kidding me!?
units.displayText: Are... are you kidding me!?

spans.text: Are... are you kidding me!?

units.rawText: My loyalty will always be to Lord Eosphorus... So don't push it!
units.displayText: My loyalty will always be to Lord Eosphorus... So don't push it!

spans.text: My loyalty will always be to Lord Eosphorus... So don't push it!

units.rawText: Uwah, I wasn't serious, don't get so mad...
units.displayText: Uwah, I wasn't serious, don't get so mad...

spans.text: Uwah, I wasn't serious, don't get so mad...

units.rawText: Hmph, don't get the wrong idea. We're just working together. I could abandon you at any moment, even right now!
units.displayText: Hmph, don't get the wrong idea. We're just working together. I could abandon you at any moment, even right now!

spans.text: Hmph, don't get the wrong idea. We're just working together. I could abandon you at any moment, even right now!

units.rawText: Once I return to the Reverse Babylon Tower, I'll be submitting a report on all this to Lord Eosphorus. He's the one who'll decide how to deal with you.
units.displayText: Once I return to the Reverse Babylon Tower, I'll be submitting a report on all this to Lord Eosphorus. He's the one who'll decide how to deal with you.

spans.text: Once I return to the Reverse Babylon Tower, I'll be submitting a report on all this to Lord Eosphorus. He's the one who'll decide how to deal with you.

units.rawText: When the time comes, we might end up being enemies.
units.displayText: When the time comes, we might end up being enemies.

spans.text: When the time comes, we might end up being enemies.

units.rawText: Aw, come on, all you have to do is put in a good word for us...
units.displayText: Aw, come on, all you have to do is put in a good word for us...

spans.text: Aw, come on, all you have to do is put in a good word for us...

units.rawText: I told you, I won't betray my beliefs like that! Our faith is...
units.displayText: I told you, I won't betray my beliefs like that! Our faith is...

spans.text: I told you, I won't betray my beliefs like that! Our faith is...

units.rawText: Everyone, we're here.
units.displayText: Everyone, we're here.

spans.text: Everyone, we're here.

units.rawText: This is... What the hell is this!?
units.displayText: This is... What the hell is this!?

spans.text: This is... What the hell is this!?

units.rawText: The sight before us is beyond our imagination. The entrance to the garden is completely overgrown by densely-packed purple thorny vines and tentacles.
units.displayText: The sight before us is beyond our imagination. The entrance to the garden is completely overgrown by densely-packed purple thorny vines and tentacles.

spans.text: The sight before us is beyond our imagination. The entrance to the garden is completely overgrown by densely-packed purple thorny vines and tentacles.

units.rawText: We can't possibly muster up enough firepower to blast through this creepy main gate in the limited time that we have.
units.displayText: We can't possibly muster up enough firepower to blast through this creepy main gate in the limited time that we have.

spans.text: We can't possibly muster up enough firepower to blast through this creepy main gate in the limited time that we have.

units.rawText: Leave it to me. I should be able to handle defenses of this caliber. Keep an eye on Odile.
units.displayText: Leave it to me. I should be able to handle defenses of this caliber. Keep an eye on Odile.

spans.text: Leave it to me. I should be able to handle defenses of this caliber. Keep an eye on Odile.

units.rawText: Ohhhh, you're pretty reliable, aren't you?
units.displayText: Ohhhh, you're pretty reliable, aren't you?

spans.text: Ohhhh, you're pretty reliable, aren't you?

units.rawText: Please be careful.
units.displayText: Please be careful.

spans.text: Please be careful.

units.rawText: Sanctifiers, attack formation!
units.displayText: Sanctifiers, attack formation!

spans.text: Sanctifiers, attack formation!

units.rawText: [Order received.]
units.displayText: [Order received.]

spans.text: [Order received.]

units.rawText: A red laser of death extends from Wisdom's sniper rifle and touches the center of the gate.
units.displayText: A red laser of death extends from Wisdom's sniper rifle and touches the center of the gate.

spans.text: A red laser of death extends from Wisdom's sniper rifle and touches the center of the gate.

units.rawText: Wisdom seems to have poured all her operands into that attack, and even the space around her starts to warp.
units.displayText: Wisdom seems to have poured all her operands into that attack, and even the space around her starts to warp.

spans.text: Wisdom seems to have poured all her operands into that attack, and even the space around her starts to warp.

units.rawText: Bang—!
units.displayText: Bang—!

spans.text: Bang—!

units.rawText: The operand-infused sniper bullet instantly pierces through the main gate, creating a perfectly round hole in the thorny vines. The edges of the aperture are charred and smoking.
units.displayText: The operand-infused sniper bullet instantly pierces through the main gate, creating a perfectly round hole in the thorny vines. The edges of the aperture are charred and smoking.

spans.text: The operand-infused sniper bullet instantly pierces through the main gate, creating a perfectly round hole in the thorny vines. The edges of the aperture are charred and smoking.

units.rawText: Holy crap, I don't want to get hit by that...
units.displayText: Holy crap, I don't want to get hit by that...

spans.text: Holy crap, I don't want to get hit by that...

units.rawText: Wait, something's not right, they're preparing to counterattack!
units.displayText: Wait, something's not right, they're preparing to counterattack!

spans.text: Wait, something's not right, they're preparing to counterattack!

units.rawText: The other vines and tentacles suddenly surge and expand, as though they had a will of their own, and stab out at Wisdom like lances.
units.displayText: The other vines and tentacles suddenly surge and expand, as though they had a will of their own, and stab out at Wisdom like lances.

spans.text: The other vines and tentacles suddenly surge and expand, as though they had a will of their own, and stab out at Wisdom like lances.

units.rawText: What!?
units.displayText: What!?

spans.text: What!?

units.rawText: Wisdom!
units.displayText: Wisdom!

spans.text: Wisdom!

units.rawText: Sol doesn't even stop to think before charging at Wisdom, but she is too far away.
units.displayText: Sol doesn't even stop to think before charging at Wisdom, but she is too far away.

spans.text: Sol doesn't even stop to think before charging at Wisdom, but she is too far away.

units.rawText: The thorny vines and tentacles instantly engulf Wisdom, then they explode.
units.displayText: The thorny vines and tentacles instantly engulf Wisdom, then they explode.

spans.text: The thorny vines and tentacles instantly engulf Wisdom, then they explode.

units.rawText: By the time the smoke clears, Wisdom has already collapsed in a pool of liquid Entropy.
units.displayText: By the time the smoke clears, Wisdom has already collapsed in a pool of liquid Entropy.

spans.text: By the time the smoke clears, Wisdom has already collapsed in a pool of
liquid Entropy

units.rawText: Oh no! She's passed out!
units.displayText: Oh no! She's passed out!

spans.text: Oh no! She's passed out!

units.rawText: Calm down! Persicaria, I'm leaving Odile to you!
units.displayText: Calm down! Persicaria, I'm leaving Odile to you!

spans.text: Calm down! Persicaria, I'm leaving Odile to you!

units.rawText: Right!
units.displayText: Right!

spans.text: Right!

units.rawText: Antonina—
units.displayText: Antonina—

spans.text: Antonina—

units.rawText: On it!
units.displayText: On it!

spans.text: On it!

units.rawText: This is bad. If she can't keep her neural cloud conscious, she won't be able to reallocate operands to her firewall!
units.displayText: This is bad. If she can't keep her neural cloud conscious, she won't be able to reallocate operands to her firewall!

spans.text: This is bad. If she can't keep her neural cloud conscious, she won't be able to reallocate operands to her firewall!

units.rawText: The Entropy virus is attacking her base layer code!
units.displayText: The Entropy virus is attacking her base layer code!

spans.text: The Entropy virus is attacking her base layer code!

units.rawText: <color=red><size=40>Urgghaaaahhh...!</size></color>
units.displayText: Urgghaaaahhh...!

spans.text: Urgghaaaahhh...!

units.rawText: She's going to attack us!
units.displayText: She's going to attack us!

spans.text: She's going to attack us!

units.rawText: Just get her under control first!
units.displayText: Just get her under control first!

spans.text: Just get her under control first!

59.name: Entropy Liquid
59.description: An unknown purplish-black fluid secreted by Entropics. It infects and corrupts Agents and sectors.
